replenishment_policy.instruction: If no todo tasks remain, or fewer than minimum_todo_tasks remain, create a batch of new low/medium-risk tasks from docs/cognitive_architecture.md, known failing tests, TODO comments, and the current architecture gaps. Do not ask the user for more tasks unless task generation would require high-risk or critical changes.

tasks.title: Document target cognitive architecture
tasks.description: Create a project-level architecture document that maps biological concepts to engineering contracts and defines the Jules self-improvement governance model.
acceptance: docs/cognitive_architecture.md exists
agent_tasks.json validates with scripts/validate_agent_tasks.py

tasks.title: Validate agent task manifest
tasks.description: Add a stdlib-only validator for agent_tasks.json and tests that prevent malformed tasks, unknown risk levels, missing acceptance criteria and invalid path scopes.
acceptance: python scripts/validate_agent_tasks.py agent_tasks.json
pytest tests/test_agent_tasks.py

tasks.title: Implement Amygdala/RiskSystem for change classification
tasks.description: Create a risk classifier that scores file changes and action requests before tool execution or auto-merge decisions.
acceptance: changes to workflows are high risk
changes to requirements are high risk
docs-only changes are low risk
sandbox and skill registry changes are high risk

tasks.title: Implement Salience Network
tasks.description: Add a module that scores events by urgency, active task relevance, CI/test signal, uncertainty, novelty and risk.
acceptance: noisy low-value input receives low salience
failed CI event receives high salience
security-risk event receives high salience
Consciousness can use salience without changing public API

tasks.title: Introduce Global Workspace
tasks.description: Refactor the central cognitive loop so multiple candidate events compete for focus before memory retrieval, planning and action selection.
acceptance: workspace selects highest-salience candidate
suppressed candidates remain inspectable
existing /process API behavior remains compatible
planner still receives the focused user input

tasks.title: Split memory into working, episodic, semantic and procedural layers
tasks.description: Reduce confusion between MemorySystem.long_term, LongTermMemory and habit storage by introducing explicit memory layer contracts.
acceptance: working memory is bounded and non-persistent
episodic memory stores events
semantic memory stores stable project/user facts
procedural memory stores reusable successful methods
existing user_id filtering remains supported

tasks.title: Upgrade Subconsciousness into structured consolidation
tasks.description: Make the background loop produce structured summaries, lessons, anti-patterns and proposed tasks instead of only generic reflection.
acceptance: reflection output is validated JSON
lessons are stored separately from raw conversation
recurring failures can create proposed tasks
LLM calls remain mocked in tests

tasks.title: Implement Semantic Memory Vector Store
tasks.description: Replace basic string matching with ChromaDB embeddings for better contextual retrieval.
acceptance: ChromaDB is used for storing semantic memory
Retrieval returns relevant semantic matches based on embedding distances

tasks.title: Implement Procedural Memory Skill Tracker
tasks.description: Store reusable skill execution paths to improve planner accuracy.
acceptance: Procedural memory explicitly stores successful tool/skill methods
Planner has access to procedural memory during generation

tasks.title: Add Task Action Trace Telemetry
tasks.description: Track agent reasoning paths and tool usage frequency, inspired by Claude Code's telemetry.
acceptance: Telemetry module logs usage frequency of tools
Reasoning paths are structurally recorded for later Subconscious reflection

tasks.title: Dynamic Topology Tool Routing
tasks.description: Implement a dynamic routing layer inspired by Hermes, allowing the agent to self-organize which tools should be loaded into context based on the current workspace focus rather than static injection.
acceptance: SkillRegistry supports dynamic contextual filtering
Router evaluates workspace focus to limit active tool schema size
Reduces LLM token usage for irrelevant tools

tasks.title: Streaming Event Response
tasks.description: Refactor Consciousness API to support streaming tokens and intermediate thought events via Server-Sent Events (SSE), inspired by OpenAI Agents SDK.
acceptance: API exposes a /process_stream endpoint
LLMClient supports an async token generator
Consumers can stream partial thoughts and final responses

tasks.title: Self-Correcting Code Interpreter Loop
tasks.description: Enhance the Sandbox skill with an internal retry loop. If a script fails, the agent automatically reflects on the stderr traceback and attempts a fix up to 3 times, inspired by OpenClaw and Claude Code.
acceptance: Sandbox catches execution errors internally
An internal LLM call generates a corrected script based on stderr
Fails gracefully after max_retries without crashing the main loop
